stage: prospective bounded empirical pilot after three known seed cases; not preregistered
title: Information preservation and incomplete repairs along MCP result-to-model paths
questions: RQ1: At which observable boundary is source result information dropped, masked, or reclassified?
RQ2: Do real historical repairs restore the downstream path, and under which result types or branches do they remain incomplete?
RQ3: Which local checks disagree with downstream message preservation, and what task-relevant consequences can be demonstrated?

sampling.type: purposive keyword retrieval plus declared seed expansion; not prevalence estimation
sampling.selection: Deduplicate repository/number; screen all retrieved title/body records. Deep-audit up to 20 plausible records, prioritizing executable open source, explicit version, linked fix, distinct project and boundary. Record all exclusions and unresolved records; linked reports from seeds are separately marked.

inclusion: Original MCP result exists or can be reconstructed from reported version/source
An adapter, validator, serializer or message builder changes availability/meaning
Observable downstream recipient and version can be specified
exclusion: Deliberate documented presentation choice without demonstrated loss of required information
Security assertion without source or reproducible behavior

coding.unit: one root-cause incident; PRs, comments and versions are linked evidence, not new bugs
coding.incomplete_repair: A verified historical first repair satisfies a stated local check but leaves a source-backed downstream obligation unsatisfied, or a subsequent repair fixes the same obligation in an omitted path. An unresolved report or authored error fixture alone is insufficient.
coding.coder: Independent human agreement has not been established.

controls: same original payload and dependencies for component patch ablation
metrics: loss conditional on fixture/version; exact counts only
which source fields remain available at each observed boundary
local check versus downstream availability disagreement
number of distinct reproduced incidents/projects; do not count fixtures as bugs
limits: Convenience and keyword selection; no ecosystem failure rate
Known fixed bugs are existence evidence, not original discoveries
No controlled synthetic task is natural deployment evidence
No automatic claim of MUST-level specification violation
No full workflow claim from component reproduction
